pitch: Open-source infrastructure for private messaging and self-hosted meetings: chatmail relays, video, and tools around the Delta Chat ecosystem.
meta_title: TheMadOrg: open-source infrastructure for private communication
meta_description: TheMadOrg builds open-source, self-hosted communication infrastructure: Madmail chatmail relays for Delta Chat, Bedrud video meetings, SDKs, admin tools and docs.
env_stamp_alt: The TMO mark as a postage stamp
role_funders_line: Foundations, grant programs and people who fund open infrastructure.
role_selfhosters_line: Run your own chatmail relay or meeting server, on hardware you control.
role_developers_line: Build clients and tooling on the chatmail protocol, with code you can read.
role_contributors_line: Code, docs and translations are all welcome, in the open.
letter_intro: Private conversation should not depend on renting seats from someone else's cloud. So we write the servers, relays and tools ourselves, and give them away.
principle_selfhosted_body: Your messages and meetings run on hardware you control, not on rented seats in someone else's cloud.
principle_encrypted_body: A PGP-first mail policy, federated chatmail and privacy-minded defaults across the whole stack.
principle_lowops_body: Single binaries and simple install paths, so a small team can run them without a platform squad.
principle_opensource_body: Code you can read, fork and audit. Licenses vary by project (AGPL, GPL, LGPL), and every one is free to study.
projects_lede: Eight projects across the stack, from the relay that delivers your messages to the docs that explain them.
group_meet_desc: Self-hosted video that you run yourself.
group_sdk_desc: Build clients on the chatmail protocol.
group_learn_desc: Docs for the Delta Chat ecosystem.
project_bedrud_blurb: Self-hosted video meetings. One binary, unlimited users, no per-seat tax.
project_madmail_blurb: Rust chatmail relay for Delta Chat: encrypted, federated, one binary, batteries included.
project_madexchanger_blurb: HTTPS relay for routing messages between Madmail servers.
project_madexchanger_php_blurb: Pull-based HTTP mail relay for Madmail, written in PHP.
project_madcore_blurb: TypeScript library for Delta Chat–compatible web messengers (JSON-RPC over WebSocket).
project_madmail_admin_blurb: Web dashboard for managing Madmail instances.
project_relay_ping_blurb: Chatmail relay interoperability tooling: a latency matrix and a WebXDC viewer.
project_deltachat_wiki_blurb: Wiki and guides for Delta Chat, chatmail, WebXDC and related tooling.
route_lede: Our projects are stops on one route. A message leaves a Delta Chat app, crosses relays you can host yourself, and arrives encrypted.
route_app_note: Any Delta Chat client, or one built with Madcore.
route_aside_ping: Relay Ping measures how they talk to each other.
route_aside_wiki: Delta Chat Wiki explains all of it.
route_aside_bedrud: Bedrud does the same for video: your server, your meetings.
install_lede: No platform team required. These are the real install commands, straight from each project's documentation.
install_madmail_note: Downloads the release for your CPU and installs Madmail with an IP certificate. Domains work too.
install_bedrud_note: Installs Bedrud on any small VPS.
fund_body: Everything on this page is free software, built by a small team. If you fund open, private, self-hostable infrastructure, we would like to hear from you.
fund_review_title: What you can review before writing
fund_review_code: Every repository and its full history, public on GitHub.
fund_review_licenses: Licenses per project: AGPL-3.0, GPL-3.0, LGPL-3.0.
faq_what_a: TheMadOrg is an open-source organization that cares about communication. We build the infrastructure for private conversations: Madmail chatmail relays for Delta Chat, Bedrud self-hosted video meetings, the Madcore SDK, admin tools and the Delta Chat Wiki.
faq_chatmail_a: Chatmail is email infrastructure tuned for instant messaging. Delta Chat apps send end-to-end encrypted messages through a chatmail relay. Madmail is our chatmail relay: a single Rust binary that handles delivery, storage and federation.
faq_deltachat_q: Does Madmail work with the normal Delta Chat app?
faq_deltachat_a: Yes. Madmail is a relay for Delta Chat, so people keep using the regular Delta Chat apps while you run the server.
faq_free_a: Yes. The projects are published as open source on GitHub. Licenses vary by project (AGPL-3.0, GPL-3.0, LGPL-3.0), and you can run, study and change the code.
faq_selfhost_a: That is the point. Madmail and Bedrud each ship as a single binary with a one-command install, built for small teams without dedicated operations staff.
faq_fund_q: How can I fund or support the work?
faq_fund_a: Write to hello@themadorg.net. Developers and translators can help by opening issues and pull requests on GitHub.
